name: Classic
description: Upscales without AI, the way TVs do: an edge-following scaler keeps lines crisp and contrast-adaptive sharpening brings out the detail that's there, without inventing any. Built in, runs on the CPU, nothing to download. At 1x it only applies filters.
license: MIT · algorithms from AMD FidelityFX FSR 1

options.name: Scaling
options.description: Edge-adaptive follows lines and edges so they stay crisp without stairs or halos, like a TV's scaler. Lanczos is sharp and even; bicubic is soft.

options.name: Detail enhancement
options.description: Sharpening after upscaling that brings out texture without halos, and holds back where the picture is noisy.
